jobs.occupation: Workshop Mechanic - Gadbjerg, near Vejle, Denmark
jobs.description:
About us

We run a workshop about 15 km from Vejle in East Jutland, Denmark, in close partnership between GMT and Nordic Rebar ApS. You will be employed by Nordic Rebar ApS, which is based at the workshop.
GMT trades in used machinery for the rebar industry and is a well-known player in the industry across most of the world.
Together, we hold a large stock of used machines that continuously need to be inspected and refurbished, and we are therefore looking for a mechanic who will make the workshop his or her permanent base.

About the job

As a workshop mechanic, you will be responsible for keeping the workshop running and the machines in good order. Your tasks will include:

-Repair and preparation of used machines for the rebar industry
-Loading and unloading machines and accessories using a forklift truck (a valid forklift/truck licence is required)
-General maintenance and tidiness in the workshop

The workshop has an office attached to it, so you will have good colleagues around you, and we have lunch together.

The workshop has modern facilities, including a laser cleaner for removing rust and dirt, and we place great emphasis on the work being carried out safely and properly.

In the workshop itself you will typically be the only mechanic on a daily basis, so you must be able to plan and carry out your tasks independently.
 
We expect you to

-Have a technical/trade background, e.g. as a car or truck mechanic, industrial electrician, or mechatronics technician, with good mechanical aptitude
-Have at least 10 years of relevant work experience
-Hold a valid forklift/truck licence
-Be responsible and have a can-do attitude
-Be able to work independently and organise your own working day
-Not be afraid of getting dirty
-Understand and speak English
-Be an EU citizen
 
Terms of employment

This is a permanent position with Nordic Rebar ApS, on the terms and under the rules and legislation applicable in Denmark.
-Starting salary: EUR 25 per hour, paid monthly
-Weekly working hours: 37 hours - overtime may occur and can possibly be compensated with time off, among other things to allow for more frequent trips home, if needed
-Start date: as soon as possible
-Workplace: Gadbjerg, approx. 15 km from Vejle
-Accommodation (a smaller apartment/room) can be arranged locally - expected rent approx. DKK 4,000-5,000 per month max
 
Application

Applications should be sent by e-mail to ud@gmtaps.com.

Questions are welcome and can be directed to Ulrich Deichmann, GMT, tel. +45 20 98 94 44, or Arne Hansen, Nordic Rebar ApS, tel. +45 51 46 20 50.

jobs.occupation: Network & Client Management, Denmark
jobs.description:

As a Network Growth Manager, you will identify and cultivate new relationships with C-suite executives.

    Demonstrate the value of our service and convince them to become part of our exclusive business network in personal scheduled videocall meetings
    Build strong, long-term relationships with C-level executives
    Learn more about their interests, investments plans and upcoming projects
    Develop and execute strategies to expand our network and build valuable relationships, by knowing your customers key challenges and focus areas
    Contribute to the overall growth and success of Management Events

    1–2 years of client-facing experience in a commercial or B2B environment
    Previous experience with cold calling and building business relationships
    Excellent communication and interpersonal skills
    Strong business acumen and a results-oriented mindset
    Ability to thrive in a fast-paced, target-driven environment
    Passion for connecting with key industry players and driving business growth
    Proactive and persistent approach to reaching new clients and overcoming challenges
    Fluency in Danish and English

    Performance rewarded: You’ll receive an attractive compensation package with base salary, commission, and an additional starter bonus to support you as you ramp up and build your sales pipeline.

jobs.occupation: Senior Automation Manager, Nørresundby, Denmark
jobs.description:
Are you our new Automation Manager with a passion for technology, leadership, and scalable automation solutions?

At DESMI, you will play a key role in strengthening and scaling our automation capabilities across the organization. You will be part of product development & innovation leading a skilled engineering team in Denmark and China to develop reliable and future-proof automation solutions for both products and customized needs.
Working closely with Product Management, Projects, Production, and Service, you will ensure strong alignment between technical solutions and business requirements. You will be responsible for setting direction, creating structure across projects, and ensuring high quality delivery of automation solutions across DESMI's global operations.
DESMI is a dynamic and innovative company where collaboration, continuous learning, and professional development are at the core of our culture. In this role, you will have the opportunity to influence the direction of our automation landscape, develop your team, and contribute to building scalable and efficient solutions that support our continued growth.

Ideally, we are looking for someone who is:
Technically grounded
Possess strong leadership and people management skills
Structured and organized

A glimpse into the role
You will lead a team of automation engineers while ensuring that our solutions are robust and aligned with business needs. Your primary responsibilities will include:
-Team Leadership & Development: Lead, motivate, and develop a high-performing automation team, fostering a culture of collaboration, accountability, and continuous improvement.
-Project Execution & Prioritization: Plan, structure, and drive execution across multiple automation projects, ensuring clear priorities, efficient resource allocation, and on-time delivery.
-Technical Direction & Quality Assurance: Set the technical direction for automation solutions across hardware and software, ensuring reliable, serviceable, and future-proof designs.
-Operational Ownership of Automation Solutions: Oversee the development and maintenance of automation systems, translating business and product requirements into standardized, scalable technical solutions.
-Stakeholder Management: Act as the key point of contact for stakeholders across Product Management, Projects, Production, and Service, ensuring alignment and clear communication on scope, expectations, and deliverables.
-Process & Solution Optimization: Drive structured and transparent workflows across projects, continuously improving processes and enabling efficient and consistent delivery of automation solutions.
-Innovation & Continuous Improvement: Support the ongoing development of DESMI's automation portfolio by promoting a solution-oriented mindset and identifying opportunities for innovation and standardization.

Your next opportunity starts here
We're looking for an experienced and driven leader with a strong technical foundation in automation and a passion for developing both people and solutions. You thrive in a dynamic, international environment and are motivated by creating structure, driving progress, and delivering high-quality results together with your team.

We also imagine that you:
Have minimum 5 years of leadership experience managing technical teams
Bring a strong technical background within automation, electrical engineering, or a similar field, combined with hands-on experience in both hardware and software design
Are structured and capable of creating clarity and overview in complex project environments with multiple ongoing activities
Have strong planning and resource management skills, enabling you to prioritize effectively and ensure successful project execution
Communicate clearly and proactively with stakeholders across functions and organizational levels
Take a solution-oriented approach and are comfortable setting direction while supporting your team in delivering robust and scalable solutions
Have experience working in a dynamic environment where priorities can shift, and where adaptability is key to success
Are fluent in English, as it is DESMI's corporate language

The perks of being at DESMI
Flexible working hours - including possibilities for remote work.
Global career prospects - work with colleagues across Europe, Asia, and the U.S.
Skills development and career growth - Training, job rotation, and internal mobility
Pension - attractive employer contributions
Private healthcare and life insurance
On-site canteen - light breakfast, lunch buffet, and snacks
Company sports & social activities - from badminton and bowling to art clubs and summer parties

What we're about
But we're more than just pumps. At DESMI, we believe teamwork and innovation drive success.
When you join DESMI, you can expect:
A collaborative and supportive team environment.
Opportunities for continuous learning and professional development.
A chance to contribute your ideas and make a real impact.
A company that values sustainability and innovation.

We are a flat organization with an open-door policy, where decisions are made together, and ideas are always welcome. Here, doers thrive - if you see an opportunity for improvement, you have the freedom to act on it.
As innovators in reliable and sustainable flow solutions, we serve a wide range of industries from Aquaculture and Defense to Green Technologies - the list goes on. Sustainability is highly appreciated while developing high-performance and long-lasting technologies that help industries adapt to evolving markets while reducing environmental impact.

Ready to apply?
If you're a dedicated and motivated individual seeking a challenging and rewarding career where you can contribute to a more sustainable future, we encourage you to apply!

To learn more about this please contact Søren Flummer (SORF@desmi.com). We are reviewing applications on a rolling basis and encourage you to apply as soon as possible.

jobs.occupation: Researcher wanted for the Department of Depression and Anxiety, Aarhus University Hospital / Forsker søges til Afdeling For Depression og Angst, AUH
jobs.description:
Forskningsenheden under Afdeling for Depression og Angst (ADA) ved Aarhus Universitetshospital søger kandidater til en tidsbegrænset stilling (18 måneder) pr. 01. december 2026 som forsker med fokus på udvikling af maskinlæringsalgoritmer til forudsigelse af kliniske outcomes hos patienter med psykisk sygdom.

Om forskningsenheden

ADA er en del af Aarhus Universitetshospital. Vii tilbyder udredning og behandling af høj faglig kvalitet til voksne patienter med lidelser inden for det affektive spektrum. Afdelingens forskningsenhed består af en professor samt ca. 20 fuldtids- og deltidsforskere. Forskningsenheden har stor faglig diversitet og rummer bl.a. læger, psykologer, sygeplejersker, programmører og en statistiker.

Arbejdsopgaver

Arbejdsopgaverne vil bl.a. omfatte

• selvstændig forskning med fokus på udvikling og validering af maskinlæringsalgoritmer
• publikation af forskningsresultater
• sparring med øvrige forskere i Forskningsenheden
• bidrag til fondsansøgninger
• deltagelse ved seminarer og konferencer
• vejledning af yngre forskere og studerende.
Vi tilbyder

• en stilling i et stærkt tværfagligt forskningsmiljø
• tæt samarbejde med kliniske miljøer
• mulighed for nationale og internationale samarbejder.
Ønskede faglige kvalifikationer

• erfaring med forskning i maskinlæring med anvendelse af sundhedsdata (ideelt journaldata)
• formel forskningsuddannelse
• erfaring med publikation af forskningsdata i tidsskrifter med peer review
• stærke samarbejdskompetencer og erfaring med tværgående samarbejde
• forstår, taler og kan skrive dansk og engelsk (datamaterialet består bl.a. af journaltekst på dansk).
Ansættelsesforhold

Der er tale om en tidsbegrænset fuldtidsstilling (18 måneder) med opstart d. 1. december 2026.

Løn- og ansættelsesforhold i henhold til gældende overenskomst. Ansættelsen er betinget af en tilfredsstillende børne- og straffeattest.

Yderligere oplysninger om stillingen kan fås ved henvendelse til Professor Søren Dinesen Østergaard på tlf. 6128 2753 eller på mail soeoes@rm.dk.

Ansøgningsfristen er d. 22. september 2026 og samtaler forventes afholdt d. 24. september 2026.

ENGELSK VERSION 

Researcher

The research unit of the Department of Affective Disorders at Aarhus University Hospital is seeking candidates for a fixed-term position (18 months) as researcher with a focus on developing machine learning algorithms to predict clinical outcomes in patients with mental illness.

About the research unit

The Department of Affective Disorders is part of Aarhus University Hospital. We offer high-quality assessment and treatment for adult patients with affective disorders. The department's research unit consists of a professor and approximately 20 full-time and part-time researchers. The research unit has substantial professional diversity and includes, among others, doctors, psychologists, nurses, programmers and a statistician.

Tasks

• independent research with a focus on the development and validation of machine learning algorithms
• publication of research results
• sparring with other researchers in the research unit
• contribution to grant applications
• participation in seminars and conferences
• supervision of younger researchers and students.
We offer

• a strong interdisciplinary research environment
• close collaboration with clinical colleagues
• opportunity for national and international collaborations.
Desired professional qualifications

• experience with research in machine learning using health data (ideally medical record data)
• formal research training
• experience with publication of research data in peer-reviewed journals
• strong collaboration skills and experience with interdisciplinary collaboration
• understands, speaks and can write Danish and English (A main data source is medical record text in Danish).
Employment conditions

This is a full-time, fixed-term position (18 months) starting on December 1st, 2026.

Salary and employment conditions in accordance with the applicable collective agreement. The employment is conditioned by a satifying child criminal record.

Further information about the position can be obtained by contacting Professor Søren Dinesen Østergaard at +45 6128 2753 or by mail soeoes@rm.dk.

Application deadline is September 22nd 2026 and the interviews are expected to be held on September 24th, 2026.

 

 

 

Stillingen er som udgangspunkt en fuldtidsstilling.

Da Region Midtjylland løbende gennemfører besparelser og omorganiseringer, vil medarbejdere i omplacering, der søger stillingen, have fortrinsret.

Region Midtjylland er jf. EU’s løngennemsigtighedsdirektiv, der trådte i kraft 7. juni 2026 forpligtet til at oplyse dig om startløn eller et interval for startløn for en stilling inden du tilbydes ansættelse.

Her finder du Region Midtjyllands lønkatalog for de fleste faggrupper og stillinger, som findes i Region Midtjylland: Gennemsigtighed forud for ansættelse - Medarbejder.rm.dk

jobs.occupation: IRATA Level 3 Rope Access Supervisor
jobs.description:
Help us build QWC’s new Rope Access Department

QWC.dk ApS is a Danish window cleaning and specialist access company based in Glostrup. We carry out professional window cleaning, glass restoration and complex assignments where specialist access methods are required.

We are now establishing a dedicated rope access department and are looking for an experienced, proactive and hands-on IRATA Level 3 Rope Access Supervisor who wants to help build the department from the beginning.

The position

As our Level 3 Rope Access Supervisor, you will be responsible for the daily planning, supervision and safe execution of QWC’s rope access operations.

The position combines on-site supervision, practical rope access work, safety planning and client communication. You will work alongside the team and play a central role in developing our procedures, equipment setup and working methods.

You will have the authority and responsibility to stop any operation that you consider unsafe.

Main responsibilities

Your responsibilities will include:

• 
Planning and supervising rope access operations at sites throughout Denmark

• 
Preparing and maintaining risk assessments, APV documentation, method statements and rescue plans

• 
Conducting pre-work briefings and toolbox talks

• 
Ensuring that all work is carried out safely and in accordance with Danish legislation, QWC procedures and applicable IRATA standards

• 
Selecting and checking rope access systems, rigging and anchor points within your professional competence

• 
Establishing exclusion zones and protecting clients, employees and members of the public

• 
Supervising rope access technicians and verifying that team members have the necessary qualifications and competence

• 
Inspecting, controlling and documenting rope access equipment and personal protective equipment

• 
Planning emergency and rescue procedures

• 
Communicating with clients before, during and after assignments

• 
Participating directly in practical rope access work, including window cleaning and specialist façade and glass assignments

• 
Assisting with other window cleaning operations during periods without scheduled rope access work

• 
Helping QWC develop a professional, efficient and safety-focused rope access department

Your qualifications

We expect that you:

• 
Hold a valid IRATA Level 3 certificate

• 
Have an up-to-date and correctly maintained IRATA logbook

• 
Hold a current and relevant first aid certificate

• 
Have practical experience supervising rope access operations

• 
Have strong knowledge of risk assessment, rescue planning, equipment control and safe systems of work

• 
Can communicate professionally in spoken and written English

• 
Can communicate clearly with technicians, management and clients

• 
Are proactive, responsible and comfortable making safety-critical decisions

• 
Take a practical approach and are willing to work alongside the team

• 
Can work independently and remain calm in demanding situations

• 
Are willing to travel to different work locations throughout Denmark

• 
Are physically capable of carrying out rope access work

Danish language skills are an advantage, but they are not a requirement. English is required.

Experience with window cleaning, façade cleaning, building maintenance or similar specialist work is an advantage, but it is not a requirement.

Employment terms

• 
Position: IRATA Level 3 Rope Access Supervisor

• 
Employment: Full-time

• 
Working hours: 37 hours per week

• 
Salary payment: Monthly in arrears

• 
Primary base: QWC.dk ApS, Glostrup, Denmark

• 
Place of work: Various client locations throughout Denmark

• 
Holiday entitlement: In accordance with the Danish Holiday Act

• 
Start date: As soon as possible or by agreement

• 
Notice periods: In accordance with the employment contract and applicable Danish law

Employment is conditional upon the candidate obtaining and maintaining any residence and work permit required to work legally in Denmark.

About QWC

QWC is a growing Danish window cleaning company with extensive experience in professional window cleaning and challenging specialist assignments. We focus on high-quality work, professional communication and safe, practical solutions.

This is an opportunity to join us at an early stage in the development of our new rope access department and have real influence on how the department is built and operated.

How to apply

Please send the following in English:

• 
Your CV

• 
A short application

• 
A copy of your valid IRATA Level 3 certificate

• 
Documentation of your current first aid qualification

• 
A summary of your relevant rope access and supervisory experience

Send your application to kontakt@qwc.dk with the subject line:

“IRATA Level 3 Rope Access Supervisor”

Applications will be reviewed on an ongoing basis.

jobs.occupation: Tenure-track Assistant Professor or Associate Professor of Food and Ingredient Biochemical Processing
jobs.description:
Tenure-track Assistant Professor or Associate Professor of Food and Ingredient Biochemical Processing
 Department of Food Science
 Faculty of Science
 University of Copenhagen

  The Department of Food Science (FOOD), Faculty of Science (SCIENCE), University of Copenhagen (UCPH) invites applications for a position as Tenure-track Assistant Professor or Associate Professor in Food and Ingredient Biochemical Processing. The research areas of FOOD have a shared mission to contribute to new pathways for society and industry to support the development of solutions based in biology to improve sustainable food production, food security and food safety. FOOD is recognized for excellence in food research, education and industrial collaboration. The Department is an international workplace with Danish and English as parallel working languages, however it is expected that the successful candidate will be able to contribute to teaching in Danish within 3 to 6 years. FOOD has the ambition to reinforce our teaching and research in designing and optimizing biology-based solutions as future sustainable food and ingredient technologies. UCPH is strengthening this area by offering the new MSc Biosolutions program in Kalundborg, Denmark, the largest bio-based manufacturing hub in Scandinavia, home to large fermentation-based manufacturers, and a vibrant innovation environment. The candidate for this position is expected to significantly contribute to this new Biosolutions initiative.

  The aim of the position is to explore the production and use of new solutions based on both biology and engineering addressing sustainability challenges inherent in food systems today. Although we welcome a diverse range of applicants, the focus of the position will be processing in relation to biochemically based solutions and could include the following disciplines:

   	
• Food process technology, ideally with an emphasis on fermentation & downstream processing 	
• Food process system engineering 	
• Use of sensor technologies such as in-line or at line spectroscopic tools 	
• Large-data, modelling and prediction of food and ingredient processes. 	
• Understanding of biological production systems and their use, and with an emphasis on downstream processing     A central part of the activities anchored to this position will be taking place in Campus Kalundborg, and it is crucial that the candidate is able to leverage the local ecosystem to foster strong collaboration with industry. Qualifications are expected in the following areas:

   	
• A collaborative and innovative mindset 	
• Documented scientific impact and outreach in past research work 	
• A proven track record in attracting external funding at both national and international level 	
• Experience with international collaborations 	
• Ability to establish industrial collaboration 	
• Excellent interpersonal and communicative skills   Tenure-track assistant professor
 The tenure-track assistant professor’s duties will primarily include research, including obligations regarding publication/scientific communication and research-based teaching with associated examination obligations within Ingredient Biochemical Processing. To a limited extent the position may also include other duties.

  The tenure-track assistant professor must have an academic standing showing internationally competitive research, and/or have internationally recognized high potential to make a future impact.

  Assessment of applicants for the tenure-track assistant professorship will primarily consider their level of documented, internationally competitive research. The ability to attract external funding will be considered together with outreach qualifications. Teaching qualifications are not mandatory but documented teaching qualifications and teaching experience will be considered.

  Associate professor

  Applicants are required to have university level teaching experience, documented teaching competencies and must be able to explain and reflect upon own teaching practice and portfolio. Formal pedagogical training or supervision equivalent to the University of Copenhagen teacher training programme for assistant professors is required.
 
 The candidate must be an inspiring teacher with a vision on teaching development, especially in connection with the new MSc Biosolutions program. A new campus with research and teaching facilities is currently being built in Kalundborg and the candidate is expected to contribute to setting up the facilities

  Duties include the applicant’s own research, development of the field, assessment tasks, grant applications, and research management such as supervision and training of research fellows and other staff. The successful applicant must also teach, supervise, prepare and participate in examinations, and fulfill other tasks requested by the Department.

  Assessment of applicants for the associate professorship will primarily consider their level of documented, original scientific production at an international level, including contributions to developments in their field, as well as their documented teaching qualifications. Managerial and out-reach qualifications of applicants including ability to attract external funding will also be considered.

  University of Copenhagen’s criteria for recognising merit
 General criteria apply to the appointment of assistant professor / associate professor at the University of Copenhagen. The criteria (research, teaching, Innovation & societal impact, organizational contribution and leadership) are considered as a framework for an overall assessment of the applicant. In addition, each applicant will be assessed according to the specific requirements listed in this advertisement.

  Please read more here
 
 For tenure-track assistant professors: https://jobportal.ku.dk/videnskabelige-stillinger/kriterier-for-videnskabelige-stillinger/kriterier-for-meritering-maj-2026/5a_Criteria_for_recognising_merit_-Assistant_professors.pdf

  For associate professors: https://jobportal.ku.dk/videnskabelige-stillinger/kriterier-for-videnskabelige-stillinger/kriterier-for-meritering-maj-2026/5b_Criteria_for_recognising_merit_-Associate_professors.pdf

  Applicants are encouraged to read the University of Copenhagen's Guidance on the merit criterion Innovation and Societal Impact here

  The tenure-track assistant programme
 The tenure-track programme is a career programme and an assigned mentor will provide the tenure-track assistant professors with guidance related to career development, other academic topics and administrative procedures.

  Performance of the tenure-track assistant professor will be followed via internal yearly evaluations and a mid-term and final international evaluation by an assessment committee. If the ‘final appraisal’ is positive you will be promoted as associate professor. Performance and progression towards the criteria below will be evaluated with due consideration of differences between research fields.

  After a 6-year tenure-track period tenure-track assistant professors are expected to meet the criteria for appointment of associate professors at the University of Copenhagen.

  Salary and employment conditions
 The position is open from 1 May 2027 or as soon as possible thereafter. 

  The position is covered by the Memorandum on Job Structure for Academic Staff.

  Employment is as either tenure track assistant professor or associate professor under the applicable collective agreement between the Ministry of Finance and The Danish Confederation of Professional Associations on Academics in the State. There will be an opportunity to negotiate supplements based on qualifications. You can read more about salary levels in the state sector www.loenoverblik.dk (in Danish).

  The University wishes our staff to reflect the diversity of society and thus welcomes applications from all qualified candidates regardless of personal background.

  The Professor will be a part of the Section for Ingredients and Dairy Technology. The section has internationally acknowledged expertise within novel sustainable processing technologies, protein, polyphenol and lipid chemistry, functionality, and modification of food components, kinetics, oxidation, food engineering, rheology, digitalisation, and advanced data analysis. The section is also equipped with pilot facilities for brewing, dairy and bioprocessing.  Further information on the Department is linked at Department of Food Science – University of Copenhagen Inquiries about the position can be made to Inquiries about the position can be made to Head of Department, Colin Ray (+45 93565911, colin.ray@food.ku.dk) or Head of Section, Mogens Larsen Andersen (+45 3533 3262, mola@food.ku.dk).

  Filing of application
 The position may be applied for at the tenure-track assistant professor level or associate professor level. Please note that it is possible to apply at more than one level. If applied at more than one level, separate applications must be submitted (see below).

  The application including all attachments must be in English and submitted electronically by clicking APPLY NOW below. 

  Applying for the tenure-track assistant professorship please include 

   	
• Curriculum vitae including: 	 		
• Please describe and document international network and relations 		
• Please describe and document internationally based activities 		
• Positions held at universities/research institutions outside Denmark 		
• Outreach activities, i.e. popular lectures or other activities in the media 		
• Grants held, personal or in part. Career development grants. 	 	 	
• Diplomas (Master and PhD degree or equivalent)    	
• Research plan - description of current and future research plans    	
• If available, description and documentation of teaching and supervision experience and qualifications- please describe and document: 	 		
• Experience with supervision of BSc and MSc students 		
• Teaching experience 		
• Formal pedagogical training 	 	    	
• Complete publication list 	
• Separate reprints of up to 5 particularly relevant papers   Applying for the associate professorship please include 

   	
• Curriculum vitae including information about external funding  	
• Diplomas (Master and PhD degree or equivalent)  	
• Research plan – description of current and future research plans  	
• Description and documentation of teaching experience and qualifications according to university guidelines 	
• Complete publication list 	
• Separate reprints of 5 particularly relevant papers   The deadline for applications is 28 October 2026, 23:59 GMT +1.

  After the expiry of the deadline for applications, the authorized recruitment manager selects applicants for assessment on the advice of the Interview Committee.  

  You can read about the recruitment process at http://employment.ku.dk/faculty/recruitment-process/.

  Interviews will be held on 8 March 2027.  

  Please refer to the following no. in future communication in this case: 

  211-0263/26-2N, Tenure-track Assistant Professor Food and Ingredient Biochemical Processing.

  211-0760/26-2E, Associate Professor of Food and Ingredient Biochemical Processing.

This position comes with an opportunity to negotiate a start package that will help leverage the candidate’s scientific deliverables in the initial years of employment. The negotiation for the start package takes place as part of the recruitment process. Please read about the contents of the programme and conditions, as well as UCPH’s extensive support for international researchers, here Start package programme – University of Copenhagen . 

The University wishes our staff to reflect the diversity of society and thus welcomes applications from all qualified candidates regardless of personal background.

The successful candidate will be a part of the Section for Ingredients and Dairy Technology. The section has internationally acknowledged expertise within novel sustainable processing technologies, protein, polyphenol and lipid chemistry, functionality, and modification of food components, kinetics, oxidation, food engineering, rheology, digitalisation, and advanced data analysis. The section is also equipped with pilot facilities for brewing, dairy and bioprocessing. The section has extensive collaborations on research projects with major food industries in both Denmark and abroad.

Further information on the Department is linked at Department of Food Science – University of Copenhagen Inquiries about the position can be made to Inquiries about the position can be made to Head of Department, Colin Ray (+45 93565911, colin.ray@food.ku.dk) or Head of Section, Mogens Larsen Andersen (+45 3533 3262, mola@food.ku.dk).

Filing of application
The position may be applied for at the tenure-track assistant professor level, associate professor level or full professor level. Please note that it is possible to apply at more than one level. If applied at more than one level, separate applications must be submitted (see below).

The application including all attachments must be in English and submitted electronically by clicking APPLY NOW below.
